parameter.name: minimum_height
parameter.input_constraints: Each input has a unique low/wide two-row zero rectangle and a unique taller smaller-area zero rectangle; foreground separates them, so thresholds 2 and 3 select different targets.

episodes.program_text:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((rect (tallest-rect g 0 2))
                  (r1 (nth rect 0))
                  (c1 (nth rect 1))
                  (r2 (nth rect 2))
                  (c2 (nth rect 3)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (if (and (>= r r1) (<= r r2) (>= c c1) (<= c c2) (zero? v)) 6 v))))))

limitations: This is an isolated proposal, not a production generator or authority change.
Evidence covers two complete deterministic episodes and the sole declared parameter rival.
The clean two-rectangle grammar is intentionally bounded and does not establish identifiability against undeclared rules.
